# Debrief: Istio, Envoy

These clips give an Istio and Envoy team real-world evidence on ambient mesh savings and trade-offs, Envoy Gateway migration pitfalls, and Istio's design history. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s); [From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s); [Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))

## Top 3 takeaways

1. Moving to Istio ambient reduced proxy resource allocation by 40 to 60 percent and cut version drift, though tooling like Argo Rollouts needed Gateway API plugins and extra configuration. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 9:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=587s); [The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
2. Envoy's shared pools and aggressive connection reuse caused latency spikes for synchronous services; one request per connection fixed it. Envoy Gateway also unescapes encoded slashes by default, causing 404s until configured. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))
3. Sidecars required restarting every pod to upgrade and hid which version ran where; ztunnel, a per-node L4 proxy handling mTLS, and canary-based Istiod upgrades address those pain points. ([Evolution or Revolution: Istio as the Network Platform for Cloud Native · 4:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4K6s5y8HoBc&t=264s))

## Action items

- [ ] Check synchronous backends for latency from Envoy connection reuse, and trial a one-request-per-connection circuit breaker setting on a test service. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))
- [ ] Audit apps relying on encoded paths, such as percent-2F slashes, for 404s under Envoy path normalization, and set escaped-slash handling explicitly if needed. ([From ingress-nginx to Envoy Gateway at Zapier: The Benefits, Challenges, and Migration Lessons That Matter · 8:51](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kIj2U13VZJY&t=531s))
- [ ] Inventory tooling like Argo Rollouts and cert-manager for Gateway API plugin or experimental-feature requirements before planning an ambient migration. ([The Good, The Ugly, and The Bad: Leaving Sidecars Behind with Istio Ambient Mesh · 21:59](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ToKv7JntLvY&t=1319s))
